units: pixels and seconds; no metric scale assumed

camera.type: handheld, nearly static, slow drift (no zoom: poster sizes constant within ~1%)
camera.shift_file: tracks/camera_shift.csv (dx,dy = image shift of wall vs frame 0, px; background coords = image - (dx,dy))
camera.during_ball_flight_f63_115: dx goes +2.3 -> -20.3, dy +6.7 -> +26.1 (f90) -> +8.9; use cx_bg/cy_bg for motion

objects.name: basketball

diameter_px.note: least-blurred frames 88-90 give 121-123 x 122-123; minor mask axis median 122; bbox_w is inflated by horizontal motion blur (up to ~139)

objects.name: left_poster
objects.desc: tallest framed poster (two text sheets, blue glare), left

objects.name: middle_poster
objects.desc: wide framed poster (two sheets 'Your Rights and Responsibilities as a Patient'), centre

objects.name: wall_outlet

objects.name: wall

events.event: ball enters frame (left edge, lower left)
apex of flight (min cy, image coords)
ball top touches/cut by top image edge
ball passes over right poster (colour-mask only)
ball leaves through bottom edge (last visible)
bounce on floor (out of view, between)
ball re-enters from bottom edge moving up/right
ball leaves through right edge (last visible)
